terms.comment: Classically nourishment, support (ante-classical and post-Augustan for alimentum, Lewis & Short); the legal sense is modern. Alimenta was the Roman word for maintenance.

sources: Lewis & Short: alimonium · Lewis & Short: alimentum
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 193, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
